verification_scope: All missing, disabled-only and unresolved candidate identities have primary official website, about, owner or service evidence. Enabled registrations are presence-only matches against the pinned registry; no bulk XML checks, collectors or paid services were used.

presence_definitions.registered_active: At least one same-country enabled matching registry row has RSS or sitemap address; current health is separate.
presence_definitions.registered_disabled_only: Only disabled same-country matching registry rows have addresses; reactivation is not authorized.
presence_definitions.registered_no_usable_url: Matching same-country identity exists without an enabled usable-address registration.
presence_definitions.missing: No matching direct publisher registration found; identity verified through primary official evidence; open endpoint availability remains separate.
presence_definitions.present_other_country: Direct matching publisher has an enabled address only under another registry country; do not duplicate or imply absence.
presence_definitions.needs_review: Identity or edition/service availability creates unresolved coverage attribution; do not treat as ready-to-add.

matching_note: Publisher-specific domains and explicit same-country brand aliases are matched. Cross-country rows require publisher-specific domains; similar names on unrelated domains are excluded. Shared feed-host roots, syndication credits and common ownership alone do not establish a publisher match.
endpoint_note: endpoint_candidate=null means no add-ready public endpoint declaration verified in this bounded website/about audit, not proof that the publisher has no RSS or sitemap. Existing registered addresses remain in matched_rows. Root will attach retained latest health separately.
